content_type_routes.description: Maps each content type class name to the vendor mirrors that receive its rendered output.

content_type_delivery_caps.description: Delivery limit, in bytes, in force for a rendered content type at a vendor. A missing entry means no known limit — never a fabricated one. Codex truncates root AGENTS.md past project_doc_max_bytes (openai/codex#7138). That key is CONFIGURABLE and gzkit sets it, in the .codex/config.toml it generates: Codex loads a project-local config in any directory the operator has trusted, and that file wins over $CODEX_HOME/config.toml. So this entry records the limit gzkit has ESTABLISHED. Verified by observation, not by agreement between authored numbers — gz validate --instructions-files-budget runs a codex-delivery witness that reads what Codex actually assembled (GHI #962). The generated config declares the same number; CodexDocCapCoherenceTest fail-closes on divergence but cannot see delivery.

content_type_temperatures.description: Per-vendor temperature for each content type. Each key is a content type class name; each value maps vendor name to temperature tier.

surface_content_types.description: Maps each rendered control surface to the content type that owns it — the inverse direction of content_type_routes, and the authority that makes "is this consumer on-route FOR THIS SURFACE" answerable. Without it a route test can only ask whether a consumer is routed for SOMETHING, which grades an off-content-type rendition (GHI #840).
